🍫 A LITTLE BIT OF THIS. A LITTLE BIT OF THAT. A LOT OF CHOCOLATE.

A look back at our Truffle Assortment Chocolate Making workshop on Friday night! ✨

Rolling, dipping, decorating, experimenting with flavours—and, of course, trying very hard not to eat everything before the workshop was over. 😂

Everyone went home with their own assortment of handmade truffles. Which one would you pick first? 👀
